t.zh: 岛上有两个人，a 和 b，每人要么是骑士，要么不是。「a 是骑士」「b 是骑士」的真假组成真值表的四行。
t.en: Two people live on an island, a and b, and each is a knight or is not. Whether “a is a knight” and “b is a knight” are true makes the four rows of the truth table.

t.zh: 日常的话先要译成与、或、非，才能接成电路。这一关不给出目标那一列。
t.en: An everyday sentence must first be translated into and, or and not before it can be wired. This level does not show the target column.

brief.zh: 「a 和 b 不都是骑士。」把这句话译成与、或、非，接成电路，算出它在每一行的真值。
brief.en: “a and b are not both knights.” Translate the sentence into and, or and not, and wire a board that works out its value on every row.

hint.zh: 「不都是」和「都不是」意思一样吗？
hint.en: Do “not both” and “neither” mean the same?
Which part does the negation cover?
